using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;

[Generator]
public sealed class QuietGenerator : IIncrementalGenerator
{
    public void Initialize(IncrementalGeneratorInitializationContext context) =>
        context.RegisterPostInitializationOutput(output => output.AddSource(
            "Quiet.g.cs",
            "[assembly: System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.SuppressMessage(\"ApiDesign\", \"RS0030\", Scope = \"type\", Target = \"~T:App.Marker\")]"));
}
